  - **Why it matters:** This is the clearest return-to-play update of the day.

- **Titans** have placed an **unnamed key defender** into the **concussion protocol** ahead of the opener.  
  - **Status:** No name or timetable was specified.

### Patriots note
- New England’s Week 1 report includes a **backup offensive lineman ruled out**.  
- **TreVeyon Henderson** also **made the trip**, but the report does **not specify** whether this is injury-related or a return from injury.

- Chiefs practice report Thursday for Simmons.
- Final pregame status for **Jeremiyah Love**.
- Titans updates on the unnamed defender in concussion protocol.
- Any further OL shuffling in Dallas with **Tyler Smith** sidelined.
